sql:
SELECT cls, COUNT(*) as trips, ROUND(AVG(yt), 2) as mean_yt, ROUND(SUM(yt), 0) as total_yt
FROM trips
WHERE fish_date_doy BETWEEN 1 AND 32
GROUP BY cls
ORDER BY mean_yt DESC;
SELECT DISTINCT fish_date_doy FROM trips WHERE fish_date_doy <= 32 ORDER BY fish_date_doy DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT boat, landing, COUNT(*) as trips, ROUND(AVG(yt), 2) as mean_yt
FROM trips
WHERE fish_date_doy BETWEEN 1 AND 32
GROUP BY boat, landing
ORDER BY mean_yt DESC
LIMIT 15;

SELECT MIN(fish_date_doy) as first_fished, MAX(fish_date_doy) as last_fished
FROM trips;

SELECT fish_date_doy, COUNT(*) as trips, ROUND(AVG(yt), 2) as mean_yt
FROM trips
WHERE fish_date_doy BETWEEN 60 AND 150
GROUP BY fish_date_doy
ORDER BY mean_yt DESC
LIMIT 20;

window_stats = trips.groupby('window').agg({
    'yt': ['count', 'sum', 'mean', 'max'],
    'cls': lambda x: x.mode()[0] if len(x) > 0 else 'N/A'
}).round(2)

print("Seasonal pattern (10-day windows):")
print(window_stats.tail(20))

SELECT fish_date_doy, COUNT(*) as trips, ROUND(AVG(yt), 2) as mean_yt, boat, cls
FROM trips
WHERE fish_date_doy BETWEEN 260 AND 300
GROUP BY fish_date_doy, boat, cls
ORDER BY fish_date_doy, mean_yt DESC
LIMIT 30;

SELECT boat, cls, COUNT(*) as trips, ROUND(AVG(yt), 2) as mean_yt, ROUND(MAX(yt), 0) as max_yt
FROM trips
WHERE fish_date_doy BETWEEN 280 AND 295
GROUP BY boat, cls
ORDER BY mean_yt DESC
LIMIT 20;
